ImageDescription.value: Pond water reflection of Hyangwonjeong Pavilion at Gyeongbokgung Palace with blue sky, in Seoul, South Korea. This unusual hexagon-shaped structure is estimated to have been built in the late 1860s during the reign of King Gojong. The pavilion was leaning to one side, so it was being disassembled and restored.
